widgets.text: Marble Madness: roll a marble down isometric courses against the clock. Klax: catch tiles on the conveyor and stack 3 same colours.
widgets.label: Games

widgets.text: Steep drops break the marble; momentum control is everything.
widgets.label: Marble

widgets.text: Diagonal klaxes score most. Marble: time left carries to the next race.
widgets.label: Klax

widgets.text: Practice, Beginner, Intermediate, Aerial, Silly, Ultimate. Klax: waves of tiles.
widgets.label: Marble

widgets.text: Time bonus on Marble; drop meter in Klax.
